reason: Hypothesis B proposes a cleaner, more specific test: a single intervention (annealing) that directly manipulates the proposed mediator (disorder) while holding electron count constant, with a clear predicted outcome (higher Tc, sharper transition) versus the as-cast baseline, and a straightforward falsification. Hypothesis A introduces multiple simultaneous interventions (annealing and doping) and speculative f-element effects, making the mechanism less testable and the causal link between disorder and superconductivity harder to isolate.
